sequence.approach: Existing forward pedal held below 3 m/s until body Z <= -41; no steering or velocity injection
sequence.sampling: 10 Hz decimation of a 60 Hz simulation; summary extrema use all samples

caveats: Ice and mud follow the same speed-target rule, not identical pedal waveforms or poses.
Both creep down the cross-slope under gravity; mud is not pinned in place.
The bump unloads wheels but neither measured drive loses all contact.
